open_substantive_issues.problem: Perimeter O(L) alone does not bound the r-neighborhood area or number of discarded rank cells for multiply connected rectifiable windows.
open_substantive_issues.exact_counterexample: D2 full N-by-N12 grid, r2. Put one circular hole of radius1/(10N) in a skeleton tile strictly inside each of Theta(N^2) selected cells, away from its retained odd/odd tile. The connected window has total perimeter O(N), retains those whole tiles, but the boundary-discard procedure removes Theta(N^2) tiles rather than O(rN+r^2).
open_substantive_issues.affected_scope: The additional one-window boundary-loss sentence and any uses of it. Core RM1/RM2 and explicitly Jordan GE3/UR3 do not rely on the false unrestricted version.
open_substantive_issues.required_author_action: State a rectifiable Jordan/connected-boundary window hypothesis, or a controlled boundary-component/tube hypothesis with the appropriate extra term; check affected references. Preserve v1 and provide a versioned repair.

per_claim_checks.adversarial_concern: Selected curve cells mistaken for whole-tile disks
per_claim_checks.resolution: Reconstructed separating-sign connected visits, the selected-arc no-hole escape, biconnected tile blocks and the simple outer-cycle argument.
per_claim_checks.disposition: no further substantive objection after reconstruction

per_claim_checks.adversarial_concern: Several residual components counted with one perimeter bound per block
per_claim_checks.resolution: Each unselected full arc has one consecutive retained tile chain in one block and exactly two ports if nonempty. Summed perimeter is2n_F across all blocks.
per_claim_checks.disposition: no further substantive objection after reconstruction

per_claim_checks.adversarial_concern: End tails, absent selected ranks or boundary cells exceed r bounds
per_claim_checks.resolution: Every color has at most r-1 residual ranks; coordinate ranges have width at most r including tails, giving n_F, tile and physical-diameter bounds.
per_claim_checks.disposition: no further substantive objection after reconstruction

per_claim_checks.adversarial_concern: Independent tile coordinates or ranks create unwanted logarithmic/factorial costs
per_claim_checks.resolution: Fixed endpoints and other-color crossing words reconstruct midpoint steps, whole tile geometry and every rank. Repeated selected/selected recording is harmless.
per_claim_checks.disposition: no further substantive objection after reconstruction

per_claim_checks.adversarial_concern: Rare tiles touching vertices meet unbounded numbers of faces
per_claim_checks.resolution: At most two selected arcs cross a tile and none passes through its vertices, giving at most four selected faces. Conditional known-domain filling codes have exponential area cost.
per_claim_checks.disposition: no further substantive objection after reconstruction

per_claim_checks.adversarial_concern: Arbitrary filling changes selected skeleton or adds rare events
per_claim_checks.resolution: No selected ports means an additional selected level would be a closed track. Zero rare-pair boundary flux forces zero events by nonnegative tile contributions.
per_claim_checks.disposition: no further substantive objection after reconstruction

per_claim_checks.adversarial_concern: Uniform limit collapse assumed to have connected fibers
per_claim_checks.resolution: Preimages of convex target caps under the positive homeomorphisms are connected, contain the fiber and converge exactly to it.
per_claim_checks.disposition: no further substantive objection after reconstruction

per_claim_checks.adversarial_concern: Forbidden-free interior fails at boundary vertices
per_claim_checks.resolution: All incident forbidden tiles, including outside contacts, are excluded. This gives local homeomorphisms on the full closed disk; connected fibers with an isolated point are singletons.
per_claim_checks.disposition: no further substantive objection after reconstruction

per_claim_checks.adversarial_concern: A merged coarse curve can leave and revisit via changing barriers
per_claim_checks.resolution: The one-merged-pair/two-singleton restriction fixes singleton barriers; return restores a sign and would cross one twice. No multiple-nonsingleton extension is claimed.
per_claim_checks.disposition: no further substantive objection after reconstruction

per_claim_checks.adversarial_concern: Coarse ports do not fix fine identities or an abstract map folds
per_claim_checks.resolution: Complete coarse ranks identify the same two ports. Fine identities agree at both; integration on the disk and positive boundary degree give a genuine fine tiling. Coarsening recovers it.
per_claim_checks.disposition: no further substantive objection after reconstruction

per_claim_checks.adversarial_concern: Dilation loses consecutive ranks or introduces a matching choice
per_claim_checks.resolution: Each port repeats M times at prescribed consecutive multiplied ranks; reference subdivision fixes them before insertions vary.
per_claim_checks.disposition: no further substantive objection after reconstruction

per_claim_checks.adversarial_concern: Zero-row deletion or the two-group endpoint assumed to be a general port theorem
per_claim_checks.resolution: Zero-row tracks act as a translation on the good disk. Two-group coarse grid uniqueness is a separate straight-track argument, conditional on compatible positive groups.
per_claim_checks.disposition: no further substantive objection after reconstruction

per_claim_checks.adversarial_concern: Bounded diameter alone substituted for a fixed small exterior
per_claim_checks.resolution: Deleting inactive curves changes a connected disk only by translation/rank shift. The active full arrangement has O(r) curves and deforms to a genuine small lozenge zonogon exterior.
per_claim_checks.disposition: no further substantive objection after reconstruction

per_claim_checks.adversarial_concern: One recovery error per face ignores several biconnected blocks
per_claim_checks.resolution: Aggregate perimeter controls small areas by isoperimetry; only O(1/delta) large blocks remain. The sqrt(delta)+eta/delta sum and order L then r are checked.
per_claim_checks.disposition: no further substantive objection after reconstruction

per_claim_checks.adversarial_concern: The primary theorem only gives pointwise convergence for one region sequence
per_claim_checks.resolution: Read the explicit Theorem4.3 statement and proof. Fixed target/mesh then tolerance and large n give the required uniform approximation class. Printed page13 explicitly includes lozenges.
per_claim_checks.disposition: no further substantive objection after reconstruction

per_claim_checks.adversarial_concern: The refined from-within requirement for every limiting height is omitted
per_claim_checks.resolution: Inset geometry and global convex-triangle Lipschitz bounds compare every admissible h to affine p near the boundary, giving the refined metric and missing-area bound.
per_claim_checks.disposition: no further substantive objection after reconstruction

per_claim_checks.adversarial_concern: A height-neighborhood theorem does not automatically bound all fillings uniformly in slope
per_claim_checks.resolution: Fixed-exterior extensions approach compact AH(T,p); finite source neighborhoods bound total count. Jensen and continuity plus finite affine covers include frozen slopes, with consistent entropy units.
per_claim_checks.disposition: no further substantive objection after reconstruction

per_claim_checks.adversarial_concern: Core topology or scalar-height phase varies within a cut fiber
per_claim_checks.resolution: Deep inset tiles form one edge-connected block; removed crossing tiles cannot enclose holes. The fixed retained physical region determines its pinch blocks and the cut heights fix all boundary vertices.
per_claim_checks.disposition: no further substantive objection after reconstruction

per_claim_checks.adversarial_concern: The limiting affine plane has inadmissible slope or unbounded local constant
per_claim_checks.resolution: Use differentiability slopes or the boundary-integral average-gradient correction, and a known local height gauge. Undo the gauge for gluing; no count or phase freedom is added.
per_claim_checks.disposition: no further substantive objection after reconstruction

per_claim_checks.adversarial_concern: Fixed-width defects after dilation or reversed limit orders invalidate recovery
per_claim_checks.resolution: LC3 is used at a fixed chosen tolerance, uniformly over MQ; relative original strip width is already below it. r_j large precedes M to infinity at each fixed j. Product insertions recover by restriction.
per_claim_checks.disposition: no further substantive objection after reconstruction
